paragraphs.text: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judaea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of the region of Ituraea and Trachonitis, and Lysanias tetrarch of Abilene,
paragraphs.original: Ἐν ἔτει δὲ πεντεκαιδεκάτῳ τῆς ἡγεμονίας Τιβερίου Καίσαρος, ἡγεμονεύοντος Ποντίου Πιλάτου τῆς Ἰουδαίας, καὶ τετρααρχοῦντος τῆς Γαλιλαίας Ἡρῴδου, Φιλίππου δὲ τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ τετρααρχοῦντος τῆς Ἰτουραίας καὶ Τραχωνίτιδος χώρας, καὶ Λυσανίου τῆς Ἀβιληνῆς τετρααρχοῦντος,
paragraphs.translit: En etei de pentekaidekatō tēs hēgemonias Tiberiou Kaisaros, hēgemoneuontos Pontiou Pilatou tēs Ioudaias, kai tetraarchountos tēs Galilaias Hērōdou, Philippou de tou adelphou autou tetraarchountos tēs Itouraias kai Trachōnitidos chōras, kai Lysaniou tēs Abilēnēs tetraarchountos,

paragraphs.text: in the highpriesthood of Annas and Caiaphas, the word of God came unto John the son of Zacharias in the wilderness.
paragraphs.original: ἐπὶ ἀρχιερέως Ἅννα καὶ Καϊάφα, ἐγένετο ῥῆμα θεοῦ ἐπὶ Ἰωάννην τὸν Ζαχαρίου υἱὸν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ.
paragraphs.translit: epi archiereōs Hanna kai Kaiapha, egeneto rhēma theou epi Iōannēn ton Zachariou hyion en tē erēmō.

paragraphs.text: And he came into all the region round about the Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance unto remission of sins;
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἦλθεν εἰς πᾶσαν περίχωρον τοῦ Ἰορδάνου κηρύσσων βάπτισμα μετανοίας εἰς ἄφεσιν ἁμαρτιῶν,
paragraphs.translit: kai ēlthen eis pasan perichōron tou Iordanou kēryssōn baptisma metanoias eis aphesin hamartiōn,

paragraphs.text: as it is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Make ye ready the way of the Lord, Make his paths straight.
paragraphs.original: ὡς γέγραπται ἐν βίβλῳ λόγων Ἠσαΐου τοῦ προφήτου· Φωνὴ βοῶντος ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ· Ἑτοιμάσατε τὴν ὁδὸν κυρίου, εὐθείας ποιεῖτε τὰς τρίβους αὐτοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: hōs gegraptai en biblō logōn Ēsaiou tou prophētou· Phōnē boōntos en tē erēmō· Hetoimasate tēn hodon kyriou, eutheias poieite tas tribous autou.

paragraphs.text: Every valley shall be filled, And every mountain and hill shall be brought low; And the crooked shall become straight, And the rough ways smooth;
paragraphs.original: πᾶσα φάραγξ πληρωθήσεται καὶ πᾶν ὄρος καὶ βουνὸς ταπεινωθήσεται, καὶ ἔσται τὰ σκολιὰ εἰς εὐθείαν καὶ αἱ τραχεῖαι εἰς ὁδοὺς λείας·
paragraphs.translit: pasa pharanx plērōthēsetai kai pan oros kai bounos tapeinōthēsetai, kai estai ta skolia eis eutheian kai hai tracheiai eis hodous leias·

paragraphs.text: And all flesh shall see the salvation of God.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ὄψεται πᾶσα σὰρξ τὸ σωτήριον τοῦ θεοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: kai opsetai pasa sarx to sōtērion tou theou.

paragraphs.text: He said therefore to the multitudes that went out to be baptized of him, Ye offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
paragraphs.original: Ἔλεγεν οὖν τοῖς ἐκπορευομένοις ὄχλοις βαπτισθῆναι ὑπʼ αὐτοῦ· Γεννήματα ἐχιδνῶν, τίς ὑπέδειξεν ὑμῖν φυγεῖν ἀπὸ τῆς μελλούσης ὀργῆς;
paragraphs.translit: Elegen oun tois ekporeuomenois ochlois baptisthēnai hypʼ autou· Gennēmata echidnōn, tis hypedeixen hymin phygein apo tēs mellousēs orgēs;

paragraphs.text: Bring forth therefore fruits worthy of repentance, and begin not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, that God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.
paragraphs.original: ποιήσατε οὖν καρποὺς ἀξίους τῆς μετανοίας· καὶ μὴ ἄρξησθε λέγειν ἐν ἑαυτοῖς· Πατέρα ἔχομεν τὸν Ἀβραάμ, λέγω γὰρ ὑμῖν ὅτι δύναται ὁ θεὸς ἐκ τῶν λίθων τούτων ἐγεῖραι τέκνα τῷ Ἀβραάμ.
paragraphs.translit: poiēsate oun karpous axious tēs metanoias· kai mē arxēsthe legein en heautois· Patera echomen ton Abraam, legō gar hymin hoti dynatai ho theos ek tōn lithōn toutōn egeirai tekna tō Abraam.

paragraphs.text: And even now the axe also lieth at the root of the trees: every tree therefore that bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
paragraphs.original: ἤδη δὲ καὶ ἡ ἀξίνη πρὸς τὴν ῥίζαν τῶν δένδρων κεῖται· πᾶν οὖν δένδρον μὴ ποιοῦν καρπὸν καλὸν ἐκκόπτεται καὶ εἰς πῦρ βάλλεται.
paragraphs.translit: ēdē de kai hē axinē pros tēn rhizan tōn dendrōn keitai· pan oun dendron mē poioun karpon kalon ekkoptetai kai eis pyr balletai.

paragraphs.text: And the multitudes asked him, saying, What then must we do?
paragraphs.original: Καὶ ἐπηρώτων αὐτὸν οἱ ὄχλοι λέγοντες· Τί οὖν ποιήσωμεν;
paragraphs.translit: Kai epērōtōn auton hoi ochloi legontes· Ti oun poiēsōmen;

paragraphs.text: And he answered and said unto them, He that hath two coats, let him impart to him that hath none; and he that hath food, let him do likewise.
paragraphs.original: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς· Ὁ ἔχων δύο χιτῶνας μεταδότω τῷ μὴ ἔχοντι, καὶ ὁ ἔχων βρώματα ὁμοίως ποιείτω.
paragraphs.translit: apokritheis de elegen autois· Ho echōn dyo chitōnas metadotō tō mē echonti, kai ho echōn brōmata homoiōs poieitō.

paragraphs.text: And there came also publicans to be baptized, and they said unto him, Teacher, what must we do?
paragraphs.original: ἦλθον δὲ καὶ τελῶναι βαπτισθῆναι καὶ εἶπαν πρὸς αὐτόν· Διδάσκαλε, τί ποιήσωμεν;
paragraphs.translit: ēlthon de kai telōnai baptisthēnai kai eipan pros auton· Didaskale, ti poiēsōmen;

paragraphs.text: And he said unto them, Extort no more than that which is appointed you.
paragraphs.original: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς· Μηδὲν πλέον παρὰ τὸ διατεταγμένον ὑμῖν πράσσετε.
paragraphs.translit: ho de eipen pros autous· Mēden pleon para to diatetagmenon hymin prassete.

paragraphs.text: And soldiers also asked him, saying, And we, what must we do? And he said unto them, Extort from no man by violence, neither accuse [any one] wrongfully; and be content with your wages.
paragraphs.original: ἐπηρώτων δὲ αὐτὸν καὶ στρατευόμενοι λέγοντες· Τί ποιήσωμεν καὶ ἡμεῖς; καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Μηδένα διασείσητε μηδὲ συκοφαντήσητε, καὶ ἀρκεῖσθε τοῖς ὀψωνίοις ὑμῶν.
paragraphs.translit: epērōtōn de auton kai strateuomenoi legontes· Ti poiēsōmen kai hēmeis; kai eipen autois· Mēdena diaseisēte mēde sykophantēsēte, kai arkeisthe tois opsōniois hymōn.

paragraphs.text: And as the people were in expectation, and all men reasoned in their hearts concerning John, whether haply he were the Christ;
paragraphs.original: Προσδοκῶντος δὲ τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ διαλογιζομένων πάντων ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις αὐτῶν περὶ τοῦ Ἰωάννου, μήποτε αὐτὸς εἴη ὁ χριστός,
paragraphs.translit: Prosdokōntos de tou laou kai dialogizomenōn pantōn en tais kardiais autōn peri tou Iōannou, mēpote autos eiē ho christos,

paragraphs.text: John answered, saying unto them all, I indeed baptize you with water; but there cometh he that is mightier than I, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to unloose: he shall baptize you in the Holy Spirit and [in] fire:
paragraphs.original: ἀπεκρίνατο λέγων πᾶσιν ὁ Ἰωάννης· Ἐγὼ μὲν ὕδατι βαπτίζω ὑμᾶς· ἔρχεται δὲ ὁ ἰσχυρότερός μου, οὗ οὐκ εἰμὶ ἱκανὸς λῦσαι τὸν ἱμάντα τῶν ὑποδημάτων αὐτοῦ· αὐτὸς ὑμᾶς βαπτίσει ἐν πνεύματι ἁγίῳ καὶ πυρί·
paragraphs.translit: apekrinato legōn pasin ho Iōannēs· Egō men hydati baptizō hymas· erchetai de ho ischyroteros mou, hou ouk eimi hikanos lysai ton himanta tōn hypodēmatōn autou· autos hymas baptisei en pneumati hagiō kai pyri·

paragraphs.text: whose fan is in his hand, thoroughly to cleanse his threshing-floor, and to gather the wheat into his garner; but the chaff he will burn up with unquenchable fire.
paragraphs.original: οὗ τὸ πτύον ἐν τῇ χειρὶ αὐτοῦ διακαθᾶραι τὴν ἅλωνα αὐτοῦ καὶ συναγαγεῖν τὸν σῖτον εἰς τὴν ἀποθήκην αὐτοῦ, τὸ δὲ ἄχυρον κατακαύσει πυρὶ ἀσβέστῳ.
paragraphs.translit: hou to ptyon en tē cheiri autou diakatharai tēn halōna autou kai synagagein ton siton eis tēn apothēkēn autou, to de achyron katakausei pyri asbestō.

paragraphs.text: With many other exhortations therefore preached he good tidings unto the people;
paragraphs.original: Πολλὰ μὲν οὖν καὶ ἕτερα παρακαλῶν εὐηγγελίζετο τὸν λαόν·
paragraphs.translit: Polla men oun kai hetera parakalōn euēngelizeto ton laon·

paragraphs.text: but Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias his brother`s wife, and for all the evil things which Herod had done,
paragraphs.original: ὁ δὲ Ἡρῴδης ὁ τετραάρχης, ἐλεγχόμενος ὑπʼ αὐτοῦ περὶ Ἡρῳδιάδος τῆς γυναικὸς τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ καὶ περὶ πάντων ὧν ἐποίησεν πονηρῶν ὁ Ἡρῴδης,
paragraphs.translit: ho de Hērōdēs ho tetraarchēs, elenchomenos hypʼ autou peri Hērōdiados tēs gynaikos tou adelphou autou kai peri pantōn hōn epoiēsen ponērōn ho Hērōdēs,

paragraphs.text: added this also to them all, that he shut up John in prison.
paragraphs.original: προσέθηκεν καὶ τοῦτο ἐπὶ πᾶσιν, καὶ κατέκλεισεν τὸν Ἰωάννην ἐν φυλακῇ.
paragraphs.translit: prosethēken kai touto epi pasin, kai katekleisen ton Iōannēn en phylakē.

paragraphs.text: Now it came to pass, when all the people were baptized, that, Jesus also having been baptized, and praying, the heaven was opened,
paragraphs.original: Ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν τῷ βαπτισθῆναι ἅπαντα τὸν λαὸν καὶ Ἰησοῦ βαπτισθέντος καὶ προσευχομένου ἀνεῳχθῆναι τὸν οὐρανὸν
paragraphs.translit: Egeneto de en tō baptisthēnai hapanta ton laon kai Iēsou baptisthentos kai proseuchomenou aneōchthēnai ton ouranon

paragraphs.text: and the Holy Spirit descended in a bodily form, as a dove, upon him, and a voice came out of heaven, Thou art my beloved Son; in thee I am well pleased.
paragraphs.original: καὶ καταβῆναι τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιον σωματικῷ εἴδει ὡς περιστερὰν ἐπʼ αὐτόν, καὶ φωνὴν ἐξ οὐρανοῦ γενέσθαι· Σὺ εἶ ὁ υἱός μου ὁ ἀγαπητός, ἐν σοὶ εὐδόκησα.
paragraphs.translit: kai katabēnai to pneuma to hagion sōmatikō eidei hōs peristeran epʼ auton, kai phōnēn ex ouranou genesthai· Sy ei ho hyios mou ho agapētos, en soi eudokēsa.

paragraphs.text: And Jesus himself, when he began [to teach], was about thirty years of age, being the son (as was supposed) of Joseph, the [son] of Heli,
paragraphs.original: Καὶ αὐτὸς ἦν Ἰησοῦς ἀρχόμενος ὡσεὶ ἐτῶν τριάκοντα, ὢν υἱός, ὡς ἐνομίζετο, Ἰωσὴφ τοῦ Ἠλὶ
paragraphs.translit: Kai autos ēn Iēsous archomenos hōsei etōn triakonta, ōn hyios, hōs enomizeto, Iōsēph tou Ēli

paragraphs.text: the [son] of Matthat, the [son] of Levi, the [son] of Melchi, the [son] of Jannai, the [son] of Joseph,
paragraphs.original: τοῦ Μαθθὰτ τοῦ Λευὶ τοῦ Μελχὶ τοῦ Ἰανναὶ τοῦ Ἰωσὴφ
paragraphs.translit: tou Maththat tou Leui tou Melchi tou Iannai tou Iōsēph

paragraphs.text: the [son] of Mattathias, the [son] of Amos, the [son] of Nahum, the [son] of Esli, the [son] of Naggai,
paragraphs.original: τοῦ Ματταθίου τοῦ Ἀμὼς τοῦ Ναοὺμ τοῦ Ἑσλὶ τοῦ Ναγγαὶ
paragraphs.translit: tou Mattathiou tou Amōs tou Naoum tou Hesli tou Nangai

paragraphs.text: the [son] of Maath, the [son] of Mattathias, the [son] of Semein, the [son] of Josech, the [son] of Joda,
paragraphs.original: τοῦ Μάαθ τοῦ Ματταθίου τοῦ Σεμεῒν τοῦ Ἰωσὴχ τοῦ Ἰωδὰ
paragraphs.translit: tou Maath tou Mattathiou tou Semein tou Iōsēch tou Iōda

paragraphs.text: the [son] of Joanan, the [son] of Rhesa, the [son] of Zerubbabel, the [son] of Shealtiel, the [son] of Neri,
paragraphs.original: τοῦ Ἰωανὰν τοῦ Ῥησὰ τοῦ Ζοροβαβὲλ τοῦ Σαλαθιὴλ τοῦ Νηρὶ
paragraphs.translit: tou Iōanan tou Rhēsa tou Zorobabel tou Salathiēl tou Nēri

paragraphs.text: the [son] of Melchi, the [son] of Addi, the [son] of Cosam, the [son] of Elmadam, the [son] of Er,
paragraphs.original: τοῦ Μελχὶ τοῦ Ἀδδὶ τοῦ Κωσὰμ τοῦ Ἐλμαδὰμ τοῦ Ἢρ
paragraphs.translit: tou Melchi tou Addi tou Kōsam tou Elmadam tou Ēr

paragraphs.text: the [son] of Jesus, the [son] of Eliezer, the son of Jorim, the [son] of Matthat, the [son] of Levi,
paragraphs.original: τοῦ Ἰησοῦ τοῦ Ἐλιέζερ τοῦ Ἰωρὶμ τοῦ Μαθθὰτ τοῦ Λευὶ
paragraphs.translit: tou Iēsou tou Eliezer tou Iōrim tou Maththat tou Leui

paragraphs.text: the [son] of Symeon, the [son] of Judas, the [son] of Joseph, the [son] of Jonam, the [son] of Eliakim,
paragraphs.original: τοῦ Συμεὼν τοῦ Ἰούδα τοῦ Ἰωσὴφ τοῦ Ἰωνὰμ τοῦ Ἐλιακὶμ
paragraphs.translit: tou Symeōn tou Iouda tou Iōsēph tou Iōnam tou Eliakim

paragraphs.text: the [son] of Melea, the [son] of Menna, the [son] of Mattatha, the [son] of Nathan, the [son] of David,
paragraphs.original: τοῦ Μελεὰ τοῦ Μεννὰ τοῦ Ματταθὰ τοῦ Ναθὰμ τοῦ Δαυὶδ
paragraphs.translit: tou Melea tou Menna tou Mattatha tou Natham tou Dauid

paragraphs.text: the [son] of Jesse, the [son] of Obed, the [son] of Boaz, the [son] of Salmon, the [son] of Nahshon,
paragraphs.original: τοῦ Ἰεσσαὶ τοῦ Ἰωβὴλ τοῦ Βόος τοῦ Σαλὰ τοῦ Ναασσὼν
paragraphs.translit: tou Iessai tou Iōbēl tou Boos tou Sala tou Naassōn

paragraphs.text: the [son] of Amminadab, the [son] of Arni, the [son] of Hezron, the [son] of Perez, the [son] of Judah,
paragraphs.original: τοῦ Ἀμιναδὰβ τοῦ Ἀδμὶν τοῦ Ἀρνὶ τοῦ Ἑσρὼμ τοῦ Φαρὲς τοῦ Ἰούδα
paragraphs.translit: tou Aminadab tou Admin tou Arni tou Hesrōm tou Phares tou Iouda

paragraphs.text: the [son] of Jacob, the [son] of Isaac, the [son] of Abraham, the [son] of Terah, the [son] of Nahor,
paragraphs.original: τοῦ Ἰακὼβ τοῦ Ἰσαὰκ τοῦ Ἀβραὰμ τοῦ Θάρα τοῦ Ναχὼρ
paragraphs.translit: tou Iakōb tou Isaak tou Abraam tou Thara tou Nachōr

paragraphs.text: the [son] of Serug, the [son] of Reu, the [son] of Peleg, the [son] of Eber, the [son] of Shelah
paragraphs.original: τοῦ Σεροὺχ τοῦ Ῥαγαὺ τοῦ Φάλεκ τοῦ Ἔβερ τοῦ Σαλὰ
paragraphs.translit: tou Serouch tou Rhagau tou Phalek tou Eber tou Sala

paragraphs.text: the [son] of Cainan, the [son] of Arphaxad, the [son] of Shem, the [son] of Noah, the [son] of Lamech,
paragraphs.original: τοῦ Καϊνὰμ τοῦ Ἀρφαξὰδ τοῦ Σὴμ τοῦ Νῶε τοῦ Λάμεχ
paragraphs.translit: tou Kainam tou Arphaxad tou Sēm tou Nōe tou Lamech

paragraphs.text: the [son] of Methuselah, the [son] of Enoch, the [son] of Jared, the [son] of Mahalaleel, the [son] of Cainan,
paragraphs.original: τοῦ Μαθουσαλὰ τοῦ Ἑνὼχ τοῦ Ἰάρετ τοῦ Μαλελεὴλ τοῦ Καϊνὰμ
paragraphs.translit: tou Mathousala tou Henōch tou Iaret tou Maleleēl tou Kainam

paragraphs.text: the [son] of Enos, the [son] of Seth, the [son] of Adam, the [son] of God.
paragraphs.original: τοῦ Ἐνὼς τοῦ Σὴθ τοῦ Ἀδὰμ τοῦ θεοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: tou Enōs tou Sēth tou Adam tou theou.
